title: Diamond blades for cutting advanced ceramic materials
description: This image shows a selection of diamond blades used for cutting advanced ceramic materials. Diamond blades are commonly employed for slicing, dicing, slotting, and sectioning hard and brittle materials such as technical ceramics. Different bond types, including metal bond, resin bond, vitrified bond, and electroplated bond, are used depending on cutting requirements and material properties. These blades are widely applied in precision manufacturing, materials research, and industrial processing. Source: https://ukam.com/diamond-blades-for-advanced-ceramics/
